description: This file defines URL patterns for the API endpoints of the core Django app, including health check, admin product and coupon management, order status transitions, and refund moderation. It imports views from core.api_views and uses Django's path function to map URLs to view classes.

classes.name: HealthAPIView
classes.description: API view for health check endpoint

classes.description: Admin API for listing and creating items

classes.name: AdminItemDetailAPIView

classes.name: AdminCouponListCreateAPIView
classes.description: Admin API for listing and creating coupons

classes.name: AdminCouponDetailAPIView
classes.description: Admin API for retrieving, updating, or deleting a coupon

classes.name: AdminOrderStatusTransitionAPIView
classes.description: Admin API for transitioning order status

methods.name: path
